subject: agent_signage.publish.publish_snapshot and agent_signage.gate.guarded_subcommand
note: Every case drives a real supported surface, not the pure checker. The 'publish' cases run the publisher end to end against a fake gh and assert the exit code, whether any gh child was started at all, and what bytes reached the child's stdin. The 'bash-boundary' cases run the PreToolUse adapter over a command string. An earlier revision's matrix only exercised check(), which proved nothing about the boundary that actually reaches GitHub.
gh: tests/fake_gh.py -- real gh is never invoked

cases.name: create-with-declared-oversight-publishes-and-verifies
cases.why: The intended path end to end: checked bytes go to gh on stdin and the readback matches.

cases.name: edit-with-no-declared-oversight-publishes-and-verifies
cases.why: The lower claim is publishable, and pr-edit is the second supported operation.

cases.name: missing-attribution-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: A rejection has to happen before any child exists, or the rejection is decoration.

cases.name: oversight-claimed-beyond-the-declaration-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: Active oversight is a declared fact with no default; prose may not exceed it.

cases.name: declared-oversight-not-stated-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: The artifact and the declaration must agree in both directions.

cases.name: review-wording-on-a-contribution-run-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: Contributor and reviewer are different roles and are adapted explicitly.

cases.name: attribution-fenced-as-a-code-sample-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: A block that renders as an example is not a statement anyone reads.

cases.name: attribution-inside-an-enclosing-html-comment-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: Wrapping the block in a comment is the other way to ship an invisible claim.

cases.name: two-attributions-never-reach-gh
cases.why: Two blocks can disagree; a substring search would pass them both.

cases.name: a-different-person-named-in-the-body-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: Responsibility is named by the declaration, not by whoever drafted the body.

cases.name: a-dropped-maintainer-disclosure-never-reaches-gh
cases.why: An agent rewriting a body must not quietly delete someone else's disclosure.

cases.name: a-preserved-disclosure-that-is-present-publishes
cases.why: The preserve check must not reject the artifact it exists to protect.

cases.name: a-failing-gh-child-is-reported-not-swallowed
cases.why: Success must never be claimed over a child that failed.

cases.name: a-body-that-reads-back-different-is-not-a-publication
cases.why: gh exiting 0 is not evidence that the published body is the checked body.

cases.name: an-unreadable-readback-is-not-a-publication
cases.why: Unverified is a distinct outcome from verified, and is not rounded up.

cases.name: boundary-denies-the-gh-pr-new-alias
cases.why: gh documents `pr new` as an alias of the creating operation.

cases.name: boundary-denies-sudo-with-an-option-value
cases.command: sudo -u root gh pr create --title t

cases.name: boundary-denies-a-control-flow-body
cases.command: if true; then gh pr create --title t; fi

cases.name: boundary-denies-a-compound-attempt
cases.why: A guarded call in the second segment is still a guarded call.

cases.name: boundary-denies-a-semicolon-attempt
cases.command: echo starting; gh pr edit 3 --body-file b.md

cases.name: boundary-denies-a-later-physical-line
cases.command:
echo ready
gh pr create --title t

cases.name: boundary-denies-a-flag-shuffled-attempt
cases.why: The subcommand is found by position among bare tokens, not by assuming it is first.

cases.name: boundary-denies-an-untokenisable-attempt
cases.why: Unbalanced quotes mean we cannot parse it, so the conservative answer is deny.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-read-only-gh
cases.why: An adapter that denied broadly would be switched off, and then guard nothing.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-a-search-whose-value-is-create
cases.why: A flag's value is not a subcommand.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-when-two-flag-values-spell-pr-create
cases.why: Flag values anywhere after the real subcommand cannot be reinterpreted as a second command.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-a-quoted-mention
cases.why: Naming the command in an argument does not run it.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-after-a-shell-comment
cases.why: The shell never executes text after an unquoted comment marker.
cases.command: echo ok # no publish; gh pr create

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-gh-text-in-heredoc-data
cases.why: Heredoc content is data for the opening command, not a later shell command.
cases.command:
cat <<'EOF'
gh pr create --repo hermes-labs-ai/r
EOF

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-a-label-only-pr-edit
cases.why: Metadata-only PR edits do not publish a body and the supported publisher does not replace them.

cases.name: boundary-denies-an-explicit-external-target
cases.why: A PR on a non-Hermes repository is an external contribution and carries the attribution.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-an-explicit-internal-target
cases.why: Internal PRs that target hermes-labs-ai/* are exempt from the external attribution boundary.

cases.name: boundary-is-silent-on-a-bare-pr-in-an-internal-checkout
cases.why: Without a named target, a checkout whose remotes are all hermes-labs-ai/* establishes an internal target.
